text:
emily: quick q — we need a canonical packaging/naming convention for Redwood Optimize "quant profiles" so downstream teams can reliably pick compatible bundles. can we brainstorm tags + minimal manifest?
raj: +1. main needs: model id, model commit/hash, quant method (AWQ/GPTQ/INT8/FP8), hw target, accuracy delta vs fp16, and a compatibility hash. also runtime ABI version.
sam: thinking about a human-readable registry key like: `optimize/<model>-<arch>/<quant>-<hw>/<semver>`; examples: `optimize/llama-2-13b/awq-int8/a100/v1.2.0`. avoids long hashes in everyday use.
lina: ops concern: we need immutable artifacts with checksum and provenance metadata (who produced, dataset used for eval, eval-suite id). plus a deprecation path for old profiles.
emily: agree on provenance. Also want to include recommended batching/caching hints and a cost-tier suggestion so console UX can surface a single click to apply a profile.
oliver: proposed tag set (minimal): `model_id`, `model_revision`, `quant_method`, `hw_profile`, `semver`, `accuracy_delta_pct`, `eval_suite_id`, `artifact_sha256`, `recommended_for` (e.g., low_latency, throughput, cost_saver).
sam: draft manifest sketch: ```json
{
  "schema_version": "optimize.profile.v1",
  "model_id": "llama-2-13b",
  "model_revision": "2026-02-11-abcd1234",
  "quant_method": "awq-2bit-int8",
  "hw_profile": "a100-80gb",
  "semver": "1.0.0",
  "accuracy_delta_pct": "-0.4",
  "eval_suite_id": "opt-eval-v3/regressions-104",
  "artifact_sha256": "sha256:deadbeef...",
  "recommended_for": ["low_latency","cost_saver"],
  "hints": {"batch_size": "8", "prefill_cache": "enabled"}
}
```
(note: manifest snippet just for discussion)
raj: small nit — manifest should avoid nested objects per packaging rules? but we can keep hints as flat k/v pairs; consumers prefer strings. also include `runtime_min_abi` and `max_sequence_len` fields.
lina: add `rollout_policy` field: can be `canary`, `gradual`, `immediate` with percentages. we need automated guards on canary (error rate/quality regression thresholds) tied to eval_suite.
emily: naming + registry keys should be indexable by Optimize UI. suggest we also store derived labels for searching: e.g., `tags: ["awq","int8","a100","low_latency"]`.
oliver: versioning guidance: bump major if quant_method changes or model_revision incompatible; minor for tuning/packing changes; patch for metadata edits. deprecate old majors after N months with notification.
deploy-bot: artifact upload succeeded: optimize-registry://profiles/llama-2-13b/awq-int8/v1.0.0 uploaded by emily at 1978723600.
emily: action items: (1) sam to formalize flat manifest schema v1 (2) raj to write compatibility/ABI doc (3) ops (lina) to draft rollout guard checklist (4) oliver to propose registry key mapping for the console. i'll start a tiny README in the registry bucket.
sam: I can have a first-pass manifest spec by EOD tomorrow. will avoid nested objects and use stringified k/v for hints.
lina: i'll draft the rollout guard thresholds and link to incident playbook.
emily: perfect — thanks all. will follow up with a short RFC later and a toy artifact to test the console picker. :rocket:
